summary.text: Brent Roberson is the Republican candidate for North Carolina House of Representatives District 23 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Patricia Smith. He is a business owner who ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Brent Roberson was born in Williamston, North Carolina, and earned a bachelor's degree from North Carolina State University in 1995.
Ballotpedia describes him as a business owner and, as of the 2022 elections, a logger and contractor.
Roberson received 13.8 percent of the vote in the 2022 Republican primary for North Carolina's 1st Congressional District.
In 2024, he ran against Democratic incumbent Shelly Willingham in House District 23 and lost, 43.5 percent to 56.5 percent.
He advanced unopposed from the Republican primary in 2026.
